rows.summary: Paginate computes the start index as (page - 1) * size so page 1 returns the first chunk; pages are 1-based.

rows.kind: sort: direction, tie-break and no mutation
rows.summary: Make rank return a sorted copy: highest score first, ties broken by name A–Z, without mutating the input array.

rows.kind: defaults override the caller and mutate
rows.summary: withDefaults now merges into a fresh object with DEFAULTS first and the caller's opts second, so caller values win and the input object is not mutated.

The cache key only used the first argument, so calls with the same first argument but different later arguments returned the stale cached value. Key the cache on all arguments (JSON.stringify of the args array) so distinct argument lists are cached separately.
loadAll returns an array of promises because it maps without awaiting; wrap in Promise.all so it resolves to the list of results.
Require a dot in the domain part of isEmail so 'a@b' is rejected while valid addresses like 'a@b.co' still pass.
Rename fetchUser to getUser in its definition and export (users.js) and at its single call site plus import (greeting.js).
Make Lru.get refresh recency by deleting and re-inserting the key, so a just-read entry moves to the newest position and is not the one evicted when the cache is full.
Fix formatDuration to compute minutes and seconds as remainders so 3725 becomes '1h 2m 5s' instead of '1h 62m 3725s'.

parseAge now validates its input: non-numeric text, empty/blank text, negatives and values above 150 throw a RangeError whose message contains 'invalid age', while valid ages are still returned as numbers.
Fix subtotal to multiply each item's price by its qty so repeated items are charged correctly, leaving the discount path unchanged.
Make removeAt copy the input list before splicing so the passed-in list is not mutated.
